No form filed on 10/28 selected "Stop work authority utilized." Every stop-work selection below is the routine pre-job item "Stop work authority was discussed."

Larry Jaramillo's form is not the mis-selection pattern and should be treated as a real observation. His narrative names a specific condition: "Location was extremely muddy and several people were slipping as they worked", and his Learn entry follows from it: "Wear rubber boots". That is a condition observed and acted on, not a box ticked out of habit. Worth passing to the customer's location contact.

Ruben Rojo's form selected "Unsafe conditions" with no narrative describing one. His only observation text is "Rod hanger/frack protector being installed and old parts being replaced", which describes the work, not a hazard. Ask him what he meant. This is his second appearance on this list; he was flagged the same way on 09/23/2026.

Jeremy Norris, Bryan Medlin and Jerry Gonzales each filed two forms on 10/28 carrying an identical or near-identical observe selection. That pattern suggests a selection being carried forward from form to form rather than made fresh each time, which is the training point Kelby raised.

Two late-arriving 10/27 forms also carried selections: Bryan Medlin (Sprayberry Driver 303H, job 36264, "Stop work authority was discussed") and Jerry Gonzales (McMaster C 2, job 36128, "Unsafe conditions" and "Stop work authority was discussed"). Neither counts toward 10/28; both are noted so they are not double-counted tomorrow.

Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, so none of those were checked. One further limitation specific to tonight: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central, so the usual second pass over the following morning's mail for late arrivals was not possible. Any 10/28 form that lands overnight is not counted here, which bears on the missing-form findings above — those are absences as of 11:00 PM, not confirmed absences.
